description: NexaMusic 0.1.4 Beta — Radio and Explore redesign, Pod selection polish, and the Smooth Blur Header experience.

changelog.title: New Things
items: Introduced Apple Music V3 lyrics as a beta style, with improved typography, spacing, word timing, and smoother lyric auto-scrolling.
Added animated interlude indicators for timed lyrics.
Added a sign-in reminder for logged-out users, with an option to hide it.
Added automatic update checks, beta-release support, background APK downloads, and update notifications.
Introduced the new scroll-responsive header, with large titles smoothly collapsing into compact titles as you scroll.

changelog.title: Improvements
items: Improved duet and multi-vocalist lyric alignment so each singer's lines retain their identity and positioning.
Refreshed Search colours and Settings icons for a more consistent appearance.
Improved playback transition timing and handoff behaviour.
Redesigned Radio station cards, including a dedicated hero card for the station currently on air.
Updated Explore featured albums, release shelves, and mood tiles with cleaner, cover-first layouts.
Added smooth scrolling title transitions and a progressive frosted-glass header across the app's main screens and detail pages.
Kept Home, Library, and Explore filter rows pinned and aligned with their scrolling content.
Improved header readability and accessibility across light and dark themes, reduced-motion settings, reduced-transparency settings, and larger text sizes.

changelog.title: Bug Fixes
items: Restored YouTube Music playlist synchronization in the Library.
Fixed guest playback ending too early on streams that do not report their total length.
Fixed the ON AIR hero appearing when a radio station is paused, stopped, or unrelated content is playing.
Fixed a crash that could occur when opening the player.
Fixed a crash that could occur when scrolling screens with the new header.
